items.title: Authority trust boundary truth source is explicit and non-overclaiming
items.context: Review docs/requirements/decisions/authority-client-role.md and related lifecycle docs, then update or add the smallest durable truth source that says Koala CLI is workflow client only; Runner CLI/Mac runner executes; Python authority issues receipts. Do not imply repo colocation solves trust.
items.userSees: 文档中能看到 “Koala CLI is workflow client, not authority; Runner executes; Python Authority issues receipts” 这类明确边界说明。
excludes: No koala-runner CLI implementation in this story
No Python authority server code changes

happy.desc: Truth source clearly separates Koala CLI, Runner CLI/Mac runner, and Python Authority responsibilities.

edge.desc: Docs explain that putting CLI and runner in one repo/package does not by itself make evidence authoritative.

adversarial.desc: Docs forbid claiming CLI local/shadow evidence or accepted-only POST responses as L2+ production authority receipts.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Koala CLI — workflow client|Koala Runner CLI / Mac Runner — execution plane|Python Authority — receipt authority" docs/requirements/decisions/authority-client-role.md
verificationEvidence.note: Lines 53/57/61 define CLI as workflow client, Runner/Mac as execution plane, and Python Authority as receipt authority.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "No overclaim by colocation|does not make CLI-shaped evidence authoritative" docs/requirements/decisions/authority-client-role.md
verificationEvidence.note: Doc includes the explicit no-overclaim-by-colocation boundary.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Transport acceptance is NOT receipt verification|not L2\+ authority|receipt-backed-l2-plus" docs/requirements/decisions/authority-client-role.md
verificationEvidence.note: Doc forbids treating accepted-only transport or CLI local/shadow evidence as L2+ receipt-backed authority.

items.title: CLI authority submission contract labels thin-client evidence as non-authoritative
items.context: Harden authority-submit / authority-contract semantics so CLI-generated authority POST envelopes cannot be mistaken for L2+ production authority unless a future enforce-mode product track supplies required runner/receipt fields. Prefer explicit metadata/helpers and smoke tests over broad refactors.
items.userSees: 测试输出显示 CLI evidence remains local/shadow/thin-client and cannot certify L2+ authority without runner identity and receipt verification.
excludes: Do not add full EvidenceEnvelope FU-1/FU-2/FU-3 implementation
Do not fake server receipts in local JSON

happy.desc: Authority envelope or submission decision exposes a local/shadow/thin-client classification that downstream code/tests can assert.

edge.desc: Enforce transport success based only on accepted=true is not described or typed as verified server receipt authority.

adversarial.desc: A smoke test proves missing producerRunId/verifierRunId/provider/model/vendor/hash/receipt fields cannot be upgraded to a production L2+ claim.

verificationEvidence.note: Classifier and authority-submit wrapper expose local-only/thin-client/receipt-backed classes with L2+ requirements including independent verifier run and command/transcript/diff hashes.
Existing authority client smoke remains compatible; authority-submit comment and wrapper label accepted=true as transport acceptance, not receipt verification.

Smoke proves missing run/provider/model/vendor/hash/signature/receipt fields, same-run verifier collapse, and accepted=true cannot upgrade CLI evidence to receipt-backed L2+. Output: ✓ authority boundary smoke passed: CLI evidence is local/shadow/thin-client, not receipt-backed L2+ authority.

items.title: Gate and status surfaces warn before CLI-only authority overclaim
items.context: Add or harden the minimal gate/status/doctor/smoke surface that tells agents and users when they are in local/shadow CLI-only mode versus authority-backed mode. The point is not a pretty UX command; it is a mechanical warning and regression test preventing “CLI alone proved DONE”.
items.userSees: 运行相关 smoke/doctor/status 测试时，能看到本地 CLI-only evidence 是 advisory/local/shadow，不是 production receipt authority。
excludes: Do not block all local development; local mode must remain usable
Do not require live Python server secrets for this milestone

happy.desc: Local/off mode remains usable and clearly classified as local evidence.

edge.desc: Shadow/enforce transport failures keep existing behavior but warning/error text does not overclaim receipt-backed authority.

adversarial.desc: A forged/local-only authority success path cannot pass a smoke assertion that requires server receipt-backed authority.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke covers off mode as local-only and prints the user-visible non-receipt-backed thin-client boundary line.
Existing shadow/enforce authority evidence flow smoke still passes, preserving transport behavior while new wording prevents receipt-backed overclaim.
Adversarial cases prove forged partial fields, missing hashes, same-run verifier collapse, and accepted=true do not pass receipt-backed L2+ classification.

items.title: Milestone 1 validation and next-milestone routing are recorded
items.context: Add focused tests and final docs explaining that this milestone only closes the CLI trust-boundary overclaim risk. Explicitly route Milestone 2 to Koala Runner CLI in the Mac/Runner repo and avoid opening or implementing it inside Orchestrate.
items.userSees: Story summary says Milestone 1 is complete, what remains for Milestone 2, and which repo owns it.
excludes: No automatic creation of Milestone 2 implementation story unless user approves after DONE

happy.desc: Focused authority/client smoke tests pass and prove the boundary classification.

edge.desc: The story output explicitly says Runner CLI/Mac and Python authority work are separate follow-up stories.

adversarial.desc: Reviewer can verify no files outside CLI Milestone 1 scope were modified and no external repo was changed.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm run test:authority-boundary-smoke && npm run test:authority-client && npm run test:authority-evidence-flow
verificationEvidence.note: Build plus focused boundary/client/evidence-flow smokes pass and prove the boundary classification.
Docs and plan state this story completes only M1; M2 belongs to the Mac/Runner repo and M3-M7 remain future work.
Scope contract passes with no violations; git status was clean before metadata-only checklist updates, proving no external Mac/Python/Runner scope was modified.

auditLog.reason: Docs implemented and independently rg-verified after Claude Code commits.
Authority classifier and submission wrapper verified after supervisor caught and fixed hash/run-independence gaps.
Gate/status warning surface is the focused authority-boundary smoke plus compatibility smoke; no live authority server required.
Milestone 1 validation, routing, and scope evidence recorded after supervisor verification.
